# AP007E2_DIRECT_PEP517_BACKEND_HOOKS
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

source_root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
out_dir = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
backend_spec = sys.argv[3]
module_name, separator, object_path = backend_spec.partition(":")
backend = importlib.import_module(module_name)
if separator:
    for attribute in object_path.split("."):
        backend = getattr(backend, attribute)
os.chdir(source_root)
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
sdist_name = backend.build_sdist(str(out_dir), config_settings={})
wheel_name = backend.build_wheel(str(out_dir), config_settings={})
print(json.dumps({
    "execution_mode": "direct_pep517_backend_hooks",
    "backend": backend_spec,
    "sdist": sdist_name,
    "wheel": wheel_name,
}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
